title: songs-of-threekingdoms
description: A Fabric mod that adds music from Three Kingdoms (2010) into Minecraft.
body:
# Songs of Three Kingdoms Music Mod

A Fabric-based Minecraft mod that triggers custom audio cues based on specific in-game events.

## Features

Plays custom music and voice lines during the following gameplay events:
- Player death
- Potion consumption
- Spawning of specific boss mobs (Wither, Ender Dragon, Warden)
- Advancement unlocking

## Supported Versions

- **Minecraft**: `26.1`
- **Fabric Loader**: `0.19.2+`


*Note: If you require compatibility with other versions, you can modify the dependencies in the configuration files and build the project from the source.*

## Usage

Simply drop the compiled `.jar` into your game's `mods` folder. You can toggle individual feature injections on or off via the configuration file generated at `config/songs_of_three_kingdoms_mixins.json`.
